## What To Look For

The FIELD_WIDTH by FIELD_HEIGHT RGBA8 array is attached directly as a color sampled field. The image contains deterministic red, green, blue, and alpha variation, so the translucent band blends with the graphite panel background while the opaque regions keep their source colors.
